notes: Original gravimetric (langasite crystal microbalance) H2 uptake on MWCNT forest at 40 C, 0-100 kPa, so I1, I2, I3 and I5 are met. No specific surface area is reported for any sample, so I4 fails. Not retracted (record.json is_retracted false); not a review; no statement that the uptake values were published before. The only area-like statements are the generic 'enlarged surface area' (Introduction) and 3.8 x 10^19 C atoms/m2 for ideal graphene with 3.3 x 10^21 atoms/g (Section 3.2, p. 3), neither a reported specific surface area of a sample.
